verdict.rationale: Cake documents its own "bulk upload tools" that import spreadsheet cap table data directly, and an upload-your-cap-table flow. However, this is framed only around initial migration of historical data; the Carta and Pulley paths are staff-run managed migrations rather than self-serve bulk tools. Missing for 10: documented bulk issuance of new grants or securities as an ongoing ops workflow, details of the bulk upload template and supported transaction types, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can upload or issue securities in bulk — a batch of grants or historical transactions — instead of entering them one at a time

citations.quote: Cake's bulk upload tools can import your data directly. Most spreadsheet-managed cap tables can be migrated in under two hours.
Upload your cap table. Accurate data matching. A human reviews it.
